node.title: Contabilidad de recursos cuánticos
node.summary: Include state preparation, oracle work, measurements and classical processing.

relations: Context qualification can define a research instance, but does not remove the cost of state preparation or establish quantum advantage.
Una ventana semántica no proporciona acceso coherente gratuito ni speedup. Preparación, extracción, actualización y readout forman parte del coste.
A quantum formulation needs a fixed task and a competent classical baseline with preparation, readout and verification costs included.
Una formulación potencial no demuestra speedup, hardware cuántico usado ni superioridad práctica.
Oracle definitions, resource estimates and demonstrated results should carry separate evidence labels rather than sharing a single quantum-performance claim.
Un objeto de investigación bien definido no equivale a un experimento cuántico ejecutado.
The deployed substrate can define a bounded research task without turning that task into a model of the entire operating system.
El modelo mínimo no representa la totalidad del sistema desplegado ni su rendimiento global.
A mathematical formulation and a plausibility argument do not establish engineering feasibility or a demonstrated quantum advantage for the historical routing system.
No se realizó aquí una evaluación cuántica ni un contraste de rendimiento.
